command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes').name; `$cmd=[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd)).output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration' }; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd)).output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration' }; `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$b -DifferenceObject `$a; if(`$d){ Write-Output ('### '+`$n); `$d } }"
